crossRefs.note: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army…
He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were…

people.name: Amasa
people.line: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab

translations.web: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together; but he stayed longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
translations.bsb: So Amasa went to summon Judah, but he took longer than the time allotted him.
translations.kjv: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
translations.asv: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together; but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
